global_invariants.rule: Every company-scoped entity has immutable non-null company_id.
Every relationship between company-scoped entities carries company_id.
Money uses exact decimal, explicit currency and direction or debit_credit where semantically applicable.
occurred, posted, value, accounting, settlement and issue dates remain distinct.
source_record is an observation and never aliases money_movement.
movement_evidence_link relates evidence and economic events without deleting evidence.
Date, amount, direction and reference only form candidates and are never a hard unique key.
Large payloads and binaries remain in object storage behind versioned opaque references.
Every JSON document has a schema reference and maximum byte size.
Published evidence and financial facts require lineage and engine/schema versions.
Company deletion never cascades into evidence or finance.
Financial account identifiers are tokenized or last4, never stored in clear in canonical fields.
